title: External evidence result — ligature-external-evidence-result/1.0
description: The versioned result document a project-declared external evidence tool produces for one obligation (chainlink #171). A project descriptor's external_evidence[] entry names the evidence kind, tool identity and pinned tool hash, command, result format and the claims the tool may establish; this document is the machine-readable observation that record-assurance ingests and G14 re-reads. It is bound to one obligation, one tool identity, and the exact Rust source snapshot under the work package's allowed write set, so a stale result or a changed tool declaration cannot keep closing an obligation. It is OBSERVATION evidence, never a deductive or bounded-exhaustive proof: its closure_ceiling says so, and it can only satisfy a requirement that explicitly accepts its external kind and non-functional claim.

format.description: Result-format version. Ligature currently reads exactly ligature-external-evidence-result/1.0; an unknown version is refused rather than guessed.

obligation_id.description: The single obligation this result speaks for. record-assurance and G14 both require an exact match, so one observation cannot be re-used for an unrelated obligation.

evidence_kind.description: The project-declared external evidence kind this result was produced for; must equal the descriptor declaration and the manifest guarantee's harness value.

kind.description: Non-functional claim vocabulary. Deliberately disjoint from postcondition-holds and callee-precondition-established, so an external observation can never satisfy a deductive requirement by accident.

version.description: Exact tool version this result came from; must equal the descriptor's pinned tool_version.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the tool build/binary this result came from; must equal the descriptor's pinned tool_sha256.

Digest over the exact Rust source snapshot under the work package's allowed write set, computed the same way record-assurance binds Verus and Kani evidence. A source edit after the result was produced leaves this hash stale.

files.description: Optional per-file listing for auditability. The aggregate source.sha256 is the binding G14 recomputes; this list is informative and is not allowed to substitute for it.

closure_ceiling.description: The strongest closure statement this evidence can support. Statistical evidence is not deductive and not bounded-exhaustive; G14 refuses a deductive or bounded closure while any external evidence participates, and points at closure_kind 'partial'.

command.description: Optional exact invocation used to produce the result, for auditability. The descriptor's declared command remains the authoritative pinned form.

scope.description: Optional tool-specific scope values (e.g. statistical_confidence, sample_count). They are merged into the achieved record's evidence.scope and can therefore satisfy a reliance's minimum_scope only by exact string equality, never by inference.

result.description: Tool-specific result payload. Open by design: the extension point must not know every tool's measurements. The binding facts above are what Ligature checks; this object is retained for reviewers.
